title: Porcelain patio and garden, Dunshaughlin
summary: On site now: a large format grey porcelain patio across the back of the house, timber pergola frames over a stepping stone path and a raised timber planter.
intro: We laid a large format grey porcelain patio across the full width of the garden, then set a stepping stone path down the garden under a run of timber pergola frames, with a raised timber planter beside it.
The photos and video show the work in progress, before the planting and finishing of the garden.
